meta.name: generate-image
meta.description: Generate or edit images with AI models through the OpenRouter Image API (Gemini, Seedream, Recraft, GPT-Image, Riverflow). Use for photos, illustrations, artwork, concept art, visual assets, logos, and image editing or compositing from reference images. For flowcharts, circuits, pathways, and other technical diagrams, use the scientific-schematics skill instead.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成或编辑照片、插画等视觉素材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为文章或项目快速生成配图，又不想学笨重的设计软件。
copy.tagline_en: Create or edit photos, illustrations, and visual assets with AI models.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need visual assets and don't want to use complicated design software.

howto.what: Claude 会运行一个 Python 脚本,通过 OpenRouter 的图像模型(如 FLUX.2 Pro、Gemini 3.1 Flash)生成或编辑图片,并把结果自动保存为 PNG 文件。使用前需要先配置 OpenRouter API key。
howto.when: 当你想要照片、插画、概念图等非技术图表类图片,或要修改已有图片时使用;流程图、电路图等技术图表请改用 scientific-schematics 技能。

say.text: 帮我生成一张日落山脉的图片
把 photo.jpg 的背景改成蓝色
用 flux.2-pro 生成一张太空猫的图

howto.what_en: Claude runs a Python script that generates or edits images through OpenRouter models (e.g. FLUX.2 Pro, Gemini 3.1 Flash) and saves the result as a PNG file. An OpenRouter API key must be configured first.
howto.when_en: Use when you want photos, illustrations or concept art (non-technical images), or to edit an existing image; for flowcharts, circuits and other technical diagrams use scientific-schematics instead.

say_en.text: Generate an image of a sunset over mountains
Change the background of photo.jpg to blue
Use flux.2-pro to generate a cat in space
